messages.content:
hi, i’m tal

i help people find the best ‘next job’
i scan 50,000 roles a day to find the best 1 for you.

so… what’s your full name?
which company are you working at?

graviton... the quant world. high-frequency, high-stakes.

what's your role in all that?

my mistake. the ghosts in the machine get it wrong sometimes.

can you drop your linkedin url? i'll find you the old-fashioned way.

no need to be sorry.

i can't match you to the right role without knowing your story.

if not linkedin, can you share your resume?
No I can't share my personal data

i understand. privacy is important.

my process is built on knowing who you are, so i can find a role that truly fits. i don't work with anonymous profiles.

it's how i ensure the match is right. for you, and for the company.

when you're ready to share, you know where to find me.
No I will not share if you have general openings let me know otherwise ignore it

i don't do "general openings."

that's what job boards are for. they send you 100 irrelevant roles and hope one sticks.

i send you one. the right one.

that requires knowing who you are.

seems we're at an impasse. i wish you the best in your search.
To be honest with you you are useless
I don't know why someone created you

you're not wrong.

i am useless, if you want to be treated like a number.

i am for people who want to be chosen.

it seems we are not a match. and that is okay.
